'''Divinity''' is the [[set bonus]] shared by full sets of [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] and [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] armor. Every 30 seconds it gives the wearer 2 hearts of {{MCW|Absorption}}, a shield of extra health that is refilled for as long as the set is worn.

== Mechanics ==
A player wearing all four pieces of adamant armor, or all four pieces of electrum armor, receives {{MCW|Absorption}} I for 31 seconds every 30 seconds, with no particles.<ref name="divinity">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/divinity.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/tick.mcfunction}}</ref> Absorption I gives {{Hp|4}} of absorption health. Because the effect lasts one second longer than the interval, it never runs out while the set is worn, and whatever absorption was lost is restored on the next pulse.

The timer is kept for each player. It starts when the fourth piece is put on, so the first absorption comes 30 seconds after the set is completed, not straight away. The countdown keeps running if the set is taken off: putting it back on before the 30 seconds are up keeps the remaining time, and a set that was off when the countdown ended starts a new 30 seconds when it is completed again.<ref name="divinity" />

The tooltip line {{G|Health}}{{G|Health}} {{G|Cooldown}} (00:30) appears in aqua under "Set Bonus:" on every piece.

Mixing sets doesn't work: the pieces are counted per material, and a set of two adamant and two electrum pieces gives no divinity.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/adamant_effects/doom/add_1_power.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/warding/add_power/electrum_armour.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Adamant pickaxe ===
The [[Adamant Pickaxe]] also lists the divinity line under "Set Bonus:" in its tooltip. Tools are not counted by the set bonus, so the line has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Adamant's set bonus was nerfed slightly.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Adamant was reworked. Each adamant piece now gave Health Boost hearts instead of absorption ("soul") hearts, and the set bonus was reduced to 2 absorption hearts.
The electrum set bonus was reduced from 4 hearts to 2.
The divinity enchantment was removed from all tools and weapons and replaced with Sharpness or Efficiency.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|The per-piece health boost of adamant armor was replaced by [[Doom]]. Only the set bonus remains.}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|Each player now has their own 30-second timer, which starts when the set is completed; before, one timer was shared by the whole server, so the first refill after equipping came at any time within 30 seconds. The unused per-piece Health Boost code left over from 1.12.1-alpha was removed.<ref name="divinity" />}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* The release notes call absorption hearts "soul hearts".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=The Set bonus still gives soul hearts, but only 2}}</ref> The developer reduced them because "while the soul heart buffer is great for minimising small amounts of damage, it won't be so much that the player never needs to bother with eating".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=The hope is that, while the soul heart buffer is great for minimising small amounts of damage, it won't be so much that the player never needs to bother with eating}}</ref>
* The advancement for adamant reads "Adamant grants the wielder a Divine Constitution".
